beats: [d:intrigue][sfx:boom][act:the surprise, confident]The Tower of ^Babel, from the Book of Genesis, had a ^real building behind it. [act:quiet, sure]And we know exactly where it ^stood: in ^Babylon, in today's ^Iraq.

[d:tension][act:measuring it out, wonder][tune:level]^Ninety-one metres on each side: nearly a football ^pitch. [act:slower, looking up]^Seven stepped stages, one on top of the ^other. [p:0.93][act:a sense of height]About ninety metres high, as tall as a thirty-storey ^tower.

[d:calm][act:introducing it, respectful]Its name was ^Etemenanki. [act:explaining, plain]It was the temple tower of the god ^Marduk, in the very middle of ^Babylon. [p:0.93][act:explaining, clear]A stepped tower like this is called a ^ziggurat: a man-made mountain of ^brick. [act:explaining, plain]Its outer skin was fired ^brick, set in ^bitumen, a natural ^tar.

[d:build][go:2|0][act:a brisk history][tune:level]Its life had ups and ^downs. [act:same pace][tune:level]^Wrecked in {689|six eighty-nine} BCE. [act:same pace][tune:level]^Rebuilt by ^three kings. [sfx:shimmer][act:slowing, the detail that matters]^Finished by Nebuchadnezzar, at the very time when exiles from ^Judah were living in the ^city.

[d:build][act:showing you, pleased]A carved ^stone from Nebuchadnezzar's reign shows the king standing ^beside the stepped tower. [act:quiet wonder, warm]It's the ^oldest picture of the tower we have. [p:0.93][act:explaining, delighted]A bit like a builder's ^photo, taken some two and a half thousand years ^ago.

[d:build][act:quoting him, a little grand]And listen to the king's ^own words, from his inscriptions: [act:quoting, grand, slower]I made workers from ^all the lands of the world carry the ^brick. [d:aside][act:warm, delighted aside]Imagine the ^noise of that building site. [act:warm, smiling][tune:fall]Every tongue, on ^one site.

[d:reveal][act:gathering it up, building]Now line them up. [tune:level]The ^name. [tune:level]The ^pun on it. [tune:level]The fired ^brick and the ^bitumen. [tune:level]The stepped ^tower. [tune:level]The many ^languages. [sfx:hit][act:the reveal, slower and sure]^Every detail of the story has a match in the ^ground.

[d:verdict][p:0.95][act:weighing it, calm authority][tune:rise]The ^tower behind the story? [act:the verdict, confident][tune:fall]^*Strong* evidence. [act:turning, with care][tune:rise]The scattering of languages in a ^day? [act:respectful, sincere and even]That belongs to ^faith, and we don't ^grade it. [act:fair, sure]But its foundations were ^excavated, and its builders' own ^words survive.
[d:tension][p:0.93][act:gentle, thoughtful]What we ^can measure... [act:the last word, a warm smile]is the ^*brick*.
